title: Recipe (tasteslikegood.org served shape)
description: Served shape of a recipe from tasteslikegood.org (GET /api/recipes/public/{slug}), checked against three live samples in docs/samples/tasteslikegood/rest/. The author states served data is always migrated to the current schema, so the served shape is the source of truth. Fields marked 'export-only' appear in the older account export (docs/Crispy_Vegan_Grilled_Cheese_Sandwich copy.json) but not in the public payload; they are internal and must be stripped at import. Optionality beyond 'required' is unverified (3 samples). Unknown extra fields are allowed.

id.description: Recipe id on the live site.

prepTime.description: Preparation time. Unit not stated in the data; minutes assumed.

cookTime.description: Cooking time. Unit not stated in the data; minutes assumed.

ingredients.description: Ingredients grouped by kind. Groups seen: dry, wet, other. Other group names may exist.

instructions.description: Served shape: array of plain strings, in order. The export shape is an array of {step, description} objects (export-only). Importer should normalise to strings.

image_keywords.description: Export-only. Keywords used to generate the image. Internal; strip at import.

ai_image_url.description: Image URL. Absolute in the served payload (same value as 'image'); a relative API path in the export. The image must be downloaded separately.

ai_image_gcs.description: Export-only. Internal cloud-storage location of the image. Do not publish.

ai_metadata.description: Export-only. Generation provenance (models, prompts, session ids, user names). Internal; do not publish.

user_id.description: Export-only. Owner id on the live site. Internal; do not publish.

slug.description: URL slug, a real field in the served payload (no derivation needed for served recipes). Absent from the export.

is_public.description: Served payload flag. Import only recipes where this is true.

image.description: Absolute URL of the recipe image on the live site. Must be downloaded by the importer.

stock_image_url.description: Stock image URL; null in all samples seen.

breadcrumbs.description: Site navigation trail. Derived by the live site; not content, do not import.

instructionStep.description: Export-only instruction form. Not present in the served payload.
